findingsFixedOnTheGo.W-DM01: the collapse-backtest's FIRST B1 run produced a FABRICATED 100% gap (worse than a miss) — root cause: TWO harness data-collection bugs (a miscounted-zeros get_dy calldata → a misaligned dx → a garbage read; a unit mismatch comparing wstETH→stETH 1.075 against stETH→ETH). FIX (conscious, disclosed, X-BACKTEST d): a proper ABI encoder + the correct read (redemption = stETH par 1.0, secondary = the real Curve get_dy 0.9429 → a real 5.71% gap matching the documented June-2022 depeg, tri-endpoint cross-checked). The fix was to script/ (the measurement instrument); src/ (the engine) stayed byte-frozen; the whole harness was re-run; the result is the true historical value, not fitted to a hit.
findingsFixedOnTheGo.W-DM02: the backtest re-hash wall first over-required tri-endpoint cross-check on EVERY hit — but B2 (dYdX) is a single-source INDEXER hit (an indexer API cannot be tri-endpoint).
